title: 40 Allies vs. Hundreds of Enemies – My Epic MegaJam Entry
author: Comprehensive-Ad-147
selftext:
**Sine Deis** is a small game I made in four days for the Epic MegaJam last week.

This is a short clip showing a moment where I pushed the NPC count to the limit (there are modifiers in the game). There are other trailers on the game page if you want to see more of it.

You can also play the build on itch.io: [https://elzean.itch.io/sine-deis-the-godless-march](https://elzean.itch.io/sine-deis-the-godless-march)

Multiplayer is supposed to work, so if you have some friends (lucky you), let me know how that goes :)

It’s not super balanced, but it is a complete gameplay loop, you take on a unique mission, earn embers to spend at the altar to upgrade your stats, and keep going.

comments.author: maxneuds
comments.body:
What I hate about the contest is that creativity and setup is only a part of it.

In the end it's a contest of how much money one is willing to throw at agent and participation is gate kept by budget. The 25$ Claude budget are burned in no time.

I like that you at least tried to use some local tools.

replies.author: Comprehensive-Ad-147
replies.body:
Yes, I already had a claude sub, so I'm not sure how much the claude + cursor credits they gave would get you. For the 3D they gave something around 420 credit with Rodin, and I mainly used that for the 3D and I'm still at 390 credits left...  
I tried to use [fal.ai](http://fal.ai) with the credit they offered to make the intro, but I burnt it all on just a few test so I ended up doing the parallax still frame type of intro with my local tools.
